title: Join Our Email List
description: Request Badger Supports news and event updates by email.

blocks.title: Join Our Email List
blocks.lead: Join our email list to stay up-to-date on our latest updates, events, and more!
body: Students, community members and former Badger Supports, Badger Support Network and SPILL supporters, staff, volunteers and leaders are welcome to request updates.
Use an email address you plan to keep. A person who manages the Google Group handles membership; sending a request does not confirm that you are subscribed.

items.text: Look for a confirmation email from Google Groups.
To complete your subscription to the email list, reply to the email you received and send a blank email. Do not use the option of clicking the ‘Join This Group’ button.
For help joining or leaving the list, email hello@badgersupports.org.
